what: Hovering the thumbnail-sized image frame before a word inside a text line opens four corner brackets by 6 units (frame side 70 units) as they appear, the frame scales 1.2x from its top left and pushes the following words by that amount, and an ink band is laid under the word from the left so the text inverts — all three are springs integrated at 1ms steps (tension 170, friction 26), so rapid in-and-out carries on smoothly. On touch, the first tap turns it on and the second tap follows.

options.pop: Cells where the brackets spread (based on 70 cells per Frame side), default 6

use: Field One

from.where: shared.js initCats (.g-cat — word links inside the intro sentence, three line art inside a frame)

note: The original re-flows the following words to avoid the enlarged frame (fading when a line wraps) and lowers the panel below. That requires measuring the whole sentence, so it exists only in the site code (shared.js flow·fades). The part only pushes words within the same group. The enlarged frame floats above neighboring text at z-index 2.
